reviewOf: artifacts/check-claims.py + METHOD.CLAIM-STATUS-INTEGRITY after Agent-3 B-CSI repair
method: DIFFERENT FROM B's in-memory probe injection and FROM author's positive coverage print: (1) break a registered home fragment and require CHK-0; (2) monkey-patch resolve_anchor to always -1 and require ~55 CHK-0 findings with home_checked=0; (3) inject a non-historical stale binding filename into architecture prose and require CHK-5; (4) inject the same with 'earlier/superseded' context and require silence; (5) compare home_total to claim count to detect corpus-scope holes outside the printed fraction.
Did not treat '24/24 homes, 31/31 restatements' as complete inventory coverage without checking denominator membership.
whatCouldHaveFailed: Self-test still passes when resolve_anchor is always miss
CHK-5 absent or matches historical cites
Printed coverage equals claim inventory (no artifact-home hole)

B-CSI-01.status: CLOSED for architecture/steering markdown homes and restatements with resolvable #fragments
evidence: resolve_anchor always -1 → 55 findings, home_checked=0 (no silent skip inside corpus)
B-CSI-01.residual: See A1-CSI-01 — six claims home in artifacts/*.json are outside the corpus and never enter the coverage denominator

B-CSI-02.status: CLOSED for the stated failure mode
B-CSI-02.evidence: self-test includes U-X unresolvable home, expects CHK-0, asserts unexamined==reported CHK-0 count

B-CSI-03.evidence: CHK-5 catches non-historical stale versioned binding filenames (negative inject of d9-exit-contract.v1.1.json → CHK-5 D9). SIGNATURES allowlist for unregistered restatements still only three claims — inventory-derived CHK-3 not delivered.

findings.title: Coverage denominator excludes artifact-homed claims — six claims never get home CHK-1
findings.detail: docs() loads only architecture/ and steering/*.md. Homes for TM, VERSIONING, RESOLVED-INPUTS, OPERABILITY, DELIVERY, FACT-IDENTITY are artifacts/*.json. Those paths are not in the corpus, so the home branch never runs: not counted in home_total, not CHK-0'd, not status-promoted-checked. The banner '24/24 homes' is true for markdown homes and false as a claim-register completeness claim (30 claims). ARCH.RETENTION-TIERS restatement into threat-model.v2.json is likewise outside corpus (1 restatement gap: 31 checked vs 32 registered).
findings.requiredFix: Either (a) include artifacts/*.json in the corpus with a JSON path/anchor strategy, or (b) require every claim home to be a markdown architecture/steering location and move artifact claims' homes to architecture sections that point at the binding artifact, or (c) fail CHK-0 when home path is outside the loaded corpus. Coverage print must be checked_locations/required_locations with required = all homes+restatements, not only those whose path loaded.
findings.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A run that lists all 30 homes as examined or emits explicit out-of-corpus findings for each artifact home.

findings.title: Register documents only CHK-1..4; validator.liveStatus is stale and contradictory
findings.detail: check-claims.py implements CHK-0 and CHK-5; register.checks lists only CHK-1..4. validator.liveStatus still says 'live C-2 promotion false negative and incomplete coverage' while the tool now prints clean 24/24 — wrong in both directions (understates current md coverage; overstates trust if read as full integrity).
findings.requiredFix: Register checks[] include CHK-0 and CHK-5 with asserts; rewrite liveStatus to name remaining holes (A1-CSI-01, SIGNATURES allowlist) without claiming the pre-repair false negative still exists unless re-demonstrated.

findings.title: CHK-3 remains a three-signature allowlist
findings.detail: B-CSI-03 asked for inventory-derived restatement coverage. CHK-5 covers versioned binding filename drift only. Unregistered prose restatements of other claims still require hand-written SIGNATURES. Known limitation of the repair, still a seal blocker for METHOD.CLAIM-STATUS-INTEGRITY.
findings.requiredFix: Inventory-derived markers or explicit claim-id tags in prose; drop or expand SIGNATURES.

findings.title: Heading-slug anchors will drift on renames (author-admitted)
findings.detail: Acceptable residual if CHK-0 fails on miss — which it does for in-corpus paths. Do not seal completeness claims that imply rename-proof identity without claim-id tags.
findings.requiredFix: Prefer explicit claim-id HTML comments or `<!-- claim:D9 -->` anchors long-term.

negativeControls.observed: CHK-5 D9 cites v1.1 but binds v1.5

sealRecommendation: Do not seal METHOD.CLAIM-STATUS-INTEGRITY. Md coverage repair is real and mutation-tested; artifact-home hole and CHK-3 allowlist remain.
whatWouldChangeMyMind: All 30 homes + all restatements in the coverage denominator with zero silent skips; CHK-0/5 in register.checks; inventory-derived restatement scan or explicit claim tags.
knownLimitations: Did not re-audit every SEALED container for residual unmarked candidates after Agent-3's seven mark fixes.
Did not design claim-id tag syntax.
